name: Adjustment
definition: Modification on the value of goods and / or services. For example: rebate, discount.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money that results from the application of an adjustment (charges. fees, discount or allowance) to the amount due.

ChargeRate.name: Charge Rate
ChargeRate.definition: Rate used to calculate the amount of the adjustment, allowance, charge or fee.

CalculationMethod.name: Calculation Method
CalculationMethod.definition: Method used to calculate an adjustment (financial adjustment, charge or allowance).

Direction.name: Direction
Direction.definition: Specifies whether the adjustment must be subtracted or added to the total amount.

AllowanceChargeIndicator.name: Allowance Charge Indicator
AllowanceChargeIndicator.definition: Indication of whether or not this allowance charge is a charge (Indicator is Yes) that should be added or an allowance that should be subtracted (Indicator is No).

ChargeIndicator.name: Charge Indicator
ChargeIndicator.definition: Indication of whether or not this allowance charge is a charge.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of adjustment applied to the amount of goods/services by means of a code.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies the payment resulting from charges due by one party to another or the payment to which adjustements (for instance charges) are applied.

RelatedLineItem.name: Related Line Item
RelatedLineItem.definition: Specifies the line item on which a financial adjustment took place.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Specifies the price which is adjusted.

CollateralManagement.name: Collateral Management
CollateralManagement.definition: Process which groups the activities related to collateral.

AdjustedBalance.name: Adjusted Balance
AdjustedBalance.definition: Balance for which adjustments are specified.

ChargesPartyRole.name: Charges Party Role
ChargesPartyRole.definition: Role played by a party in the context of charges due.

EffectivePeriod.name: Effective Period
EffectivePeriod.definition: Period during which the adjustment is applicable.

CurrencyExchange.name: Currency Exchange
CurrencyExchange.definition: Currency exchange for which adjustments such as fees or commissions are applied.

SecuritiesOrder.name: Securities Order
SecuritiesOrder.definition: Order for which adjustments are specified.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Information on the calculation method resulting in the tax amount included in the charge transfer. The tax is expressed as a fixed amount, or as a percentage of the charge amount, upon which the tax is applied.
